title: Handley Page Halifax JB848
memorial_details: Rectangular black marble tablet, with incised inscription in gilt lettering, and the remains of the aircraft's engine (to which metal tabs are attached, bearing the names of each individual crewman). The memorial sits on a paved and gravel base beneath a metal and glass canopy.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/ The crew of RAF Halifax/ G-George JB848 from/ 102 (Ceylon) Squadron Pocklington/ who lost their lives near this place on/ 29th March 1943 at 21.59 hours./ (names)/ WE WILL REMEMBER THEM
